title: Top-up rules
keywords: top up how much top-up step auto top-up low priority $1 $2 tip outsource cost
body: Auto top-up covers important customers. Manual top-up only after auto top-up ends, always in steps.
Top up gradually by priority until the fee matches the outsource cost, no later than 30 mins before the end of the pickup timeslot.
Medical and e-commerce: $2 steps after auto top-up. Medical at night: top up until it matches the outsource cost, by 8.30pm at the latest.
TikTok: top up from $1 in steps against the Lalamove price (3.30–4.30pm afternoon; after 6pm evening).
Bakes, cakes and non-movables: match the Lalamove price every 10 mins from 11am.
Shopee urgent same-day (cakes, bread, cooked food, fresh meat/seafood): mark Urgent, extend to 3 hrs, top up to $8 max, tell Fulfilment.
Low-priority customers: no top-up. Customer may tip or rebook. On a written complaint, $1–2 max.
